evidence.reason: Line 773's status check omits ignored files, and git checkout overwrites ignored files by default. If the target tracks a path where the host has an ignored local file, line 782 silently replaces it, and the post-switch status at line 786 passes because the replacement matches the target. Adding --no-overwrite-ignore to the forward checkout (and the rollback checkout at line 802) makes the switch fail before discarding host data.
